Pilih [0-9]:

usage: scrapmcp [-h] [--version] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--allow-jina]
                {scrape,batch,research,academic,list,export,report,backup,demo,doctor,read,mcp}
                ...

Scraping manual dan MCP Xiaozhi. Tanpa subperintah: menu interaktif.

positional arguments:
  {scrape,batch,research,academic,list,export,report,backup,demo,doctor,read,mcp}
    scrape              Ambil URL dan simpan hasil
    batch               Ambil URL dari file teks, satu URL per baris
    research            Riset topik; default pratinjau
    academic            Cari jurnal
    mcp                 Hubungkan endpoint Xiaozhi (prompt/env), atau MCP
                        stdio

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   Folder data (default: ~/scrapmcp-data); letakkan
                        sebelum subperintah.
  --allow-jina          Aktifkan fallback Jina Reader; URL sumber akan dikirim
                        ke r.jina.ai.
